sentences.text: 1. The present DAR has been filed on behalf of petitioners against respondents for grant of compensation in respect of death of Sh. Jasbir Singh @ Bunty @ Jagmohan Singh caused in a road traffic accident on 24.01.2019.

2. The brief facts in narrow compass, relevant and necessary for the disposal of the present case are that on 24.01.2019 at around 01.45 a.m., Sh. Jasbir @ Bunty @ Jagmohan Singh (deceased in the present case) alongwith his colleague namely Amarjeet left their working place in order to reach home.

They were on motorcycle which was being driven by deceased and Mr. Amarjeet was sitting as a pillion rider and when they reached near Janak Club District Center, a Gramin Sewa i.e. bearing No. DL4SBE7349 (here in after referred as offending vehicle) came from wrong side in a very rash and and negligent manner and hit their motorcycle, resultantly, pillion rider Amarjeet received grievous injuries on his head and Jasbir Singh @ Bunty @ Jagmohan Singh received fatal injuries.
It is also stated that the two persons came out from the offending vehicle who told his name as Mohit to Amarjeet and thereafter run away.
Deceased was taken to the hospital in one private vehicle.
PCR was called by same one which took injured Amarjeet to DD Hospital.
Later on, Amarjeet came to know that Jasbir Singh @ Bunty @ Jagmohan Singh had expired due to said accident.

Regarding the abovesaid accident, FIR No. 40/2019 dated 24.01.2019, u/s MACP No. 395/19 Manpreet Kaur and Ors. Vs. Mohit and Anr. 5 279/338/304A IPC and 3/181, 146/196, 5/80 of M .V. Act was registered.
